info.title: Seller API Test Environment
info.description:
Use the test scope of the service to set up the integration and emulate buyers actions.
To test the main work scenarios, use the test methods specified in the **Sandbox** blocks of the [Wb API documentation](/docs/openapi/api-information).

For [authorization](/en/docs/openapi/api-information#tag/authorization) you need to use the token with the **Test scope** type.

The using of the test scope does not carry the risk of unintentional disclosure of information.

tags.name: promotion
tags.description:
To access the test environment, use the `https://advert-api-sandbox.wildberries.ru` address.
Campaigns will be deleted 30 days after the last modifications.
Deleted campaigns (`-1` status) will be removed after 3 minutes.
A maximum of 50 campaigns can be created.
The maximum number of requests is the same as in the main API.

Statistics are generated only for campaigns of type `8` — automatic campaign and `9` — Auction.
To generate statistics: - the campaign must be in status `9`— on impressions - type `8` campaign must have a positive bid - type `9` campaign must have a positive bid in the catalog - the campaign budget must be positive

You can list items in the content sandbox and use it in the Promotion sandbox.

tags.name: marketplaceFbs
tags.description:
To access the test environment, use the `https://marketplace-api-sandbox.wildberries.ru` address.

You can list items in the content sandbox and use the generated listing SKUs in the marketplace sandbox.

Regular expressions are used for: - Supplies IDs — `^WB-GI-SAND-[0-9]+$` - Boxes IDs — `^WB-TRBX-SAND-[0-9]+$` # Status Model for FBS There are two types of [statuses](/en/docs/openapi/orders-fbs#tag/fbsAssemblyOrders/operation/postV3OrdersStatus) for the assembly orders: 1. **supplierStatus** — a status that can be changed by the seller. 2. **wbStatus** — a status in the system. It can only be changed by WB. In the sandbox, you can emulate WB actions by manually changing the `wbStatus` field. Use the following statuses: | **wbStatus** | **supplierStatus** | Description | How to move the order to this status | |--------------|-------|----------------------|--------------------------------------| | **waiting** | **new** | New assembly order | [Create a test FBS assembly order](./sandbox-environment#tag/marketplaceFbs/operation/postV3TestFbsOrdersMake) | | **declined_by_client** | **new** | The assembly order was canceled by the buyer. It is available for one hour after [creating an assembly order](./sandbox-environment#tag/marketplaceFbs/operation/postV3TestFbsOrdersMake), only in the sandbox. | [Notify that the buyer has canceled the order](./sandbox-environment#tag/marketplaceFbs/operation/patchV3TestFbsOrdersOrderIdDecline) | | **waiting** | **confirm** | On assembly | [Add the order to the supply](/en/docs/openapi/orders-fbs#tag/fbsSupplies/operation/patchV3SuppliesSupplyIdOrders) | **canceled** | **cancel** | The assembly order was canceled by the seller. Available at any stage until [the supply is moved to the delivery](/en/docs/openapi/orders-fbs#tag/fbsSupplies/operation/patchV3SuppliesSupplyIdDeliver). | [Cancel the assembly order](/en/docs/openapi/orders-fbs#tag/fbsAssemblyOrders/operation/patchV3OrdersOrderIdCancel) | | **waiting** | **complete** | In delivery | [Move the supply to the delivery](/en/docs/openapi/orders-fbs#tag/fbsSupplies/operation/patchV3SuppliesSupplyIdDeliver) | | **sorted** | **complete** | WB has accepted the assembly order | [Close supply](./sandbox-environment#tag/marketplaceFbs/operation/patchV3TestFbsSuppliesSupplyIdClose) | | **ready_for_pickup** | **complete** | The order has arrived at the pickup point | [Notify that the order has arrived at the pickup point](./sandbox-environment#tag/marketplaceFbs/operation/patchV3TestFbsOrdersOrderIdDeliver) | | **sold** | **complete** | The buyer has received the order at the pickup point | [Notify that the order has been accepted by the buyer](./sandbox-environment#tag/marketplaceFbs/operation/patchV3TestFbsOrdersOrderIdReceive) | | **canceled_by_client** | **complete** | The buyer has canceled the order upon receipt at the pickup point | [Notify that the buyer has declined the order](./sandbox-environment#tag/marketplaceFbs/operation/patchV3TestFbsOrdersOrderIdReject) | | **defect** | **complete** | The buyer has canceled the order due to a defect | [Notify that the buyer has canceled the order due to a defect](./sandbox-environment#tag/marketplaceFbs/operation/patchV3TestFbsOrdersOrderIdDefect) |

tags.name: marketplaceDbs
tags.description:
To access the test environment, use the `https://marketplace-api-sandbox.wildberries.ru` address.

You can list items in the content sandbox and use the generated listing SKUs in the marketplace sandbox.

For the order retrieval code in the [confirmation of receipt](/en/openapi/dbs#tag/dbsAssemblyOrders/operation/postV3DbsOrdersStatusReceive) and [rejection of receipt](/en/openapi/dbs#tag/dbsAssemblyOrders/operation/postV3DbsOrdersStatusReject) methods, you can use any combination of characters. # Status Model for DBS There are two types of [statuses](/en/docs/openapi/dbs#tag/dbsAssemblyOrders/operation/postV3DbsOrdersStatusInfo) for the assembly orders: 1. **supplierStatus** — a status that can be changed by the seller. 2. **wbStatus** — a status in the system. It can only be changed by WB. In the sandbox, you can emulate WB actions by manually changing the `wbStatus` field. Use the following statuses: | **wbStatus** | **supplierStatus** | Description | How to move the order to this status | |--------------|-------|----------------------|--------------------------------------| | **waiting** | **new** | New assembly order | [Create a test DBS assembly order](./sandbox-environment#tag/marketplaceDbs/operation/postV3TestDbsOrdersMake) | | **declined_by_client** | **new** | The assembly order was canceled by the buyer. It is available for one hour after [creating an assembly order](./sandbox-environment#tag/marketplaceDbs/operation/postV3TestDbsOrdersMake), only in the sandbox. | [Notify that the buyer has canceled the order](./sandbox-environment#tag/marketplaceDbs/operation/patchV3TestDbsOrdersOrderIdDecline) | | **canceled** | **cancel** | The assembly order was canceled by the seller. Available before [transferring the assembly order to assembly](/en/docs/openapi/dbs#tag/dbsAssemblyOrders/operation/postV3DbsOrdersStatusConfirm). | [Cancel the assembly order](/en/docs/openapi/dbs#tag/dbsAssemblyOrders/operation/postV3DbsOrdersStatusCancel) | | **waiting** | **confirm** | On assembly | [Transfer assembly order to assembly](/en/docs/openapi/dbs#tag/dbsAssemblyOrders/operation/postV3DbsOrdersStatusConfirm) | | **waiting** | **deliver** | In delivery | [Transfer assembly order to delivery](/en/docs/openapi/dbs#tag/dbsAssemblyOrders/operation/postV3DbsOrdersStatusDeliver) | | **sold** | **receive** | The buyer has received the order | [Notify that the order has been accepted by the buyer](/en/docs/openapi/dbs#tag/dbsAssemblyOrders/operation/postV3DbsOrdersStatusReceive) | | **canceled_by_client** | **reject** | The buyer has canceled the order upon receipt | [Notify that the buyer has declined the order](/en/docs/openapi/dbs#tag/dbsAssemblyOrders/operation/postV3DbsOrdersStatusReject) |

tags.name: marketplaceInStorePickup
tags.description:
To access the test environment, use the `https://marketplace-api-sandbox.wildberries.ru` address.

You can list items in the content sandbox and use the generated listing SKUs in the marketplace sandbox.

Regular expressions are used for: - Supplies IDs — `^WB-GI-SAND-[0-9]+$` - Boxes IDs — `^WB-TRBX-SAND-[0-9]+$`
Always specify the combination "11111" in the passCode request parameter of the test method for checking if the assembly task belongs to the buyer.
# Status Model for In-Store Pickup There are two types of [statuses](/en/docs/openapi/in-store-pickup#tag/inStorePickupAssemblyOrders/operation/postV3ClickCollectOrdersStatusInfo) for the assembly orders: 1. **supplierStatus** — a status that can be changed by the seller. 2. **wbStatus** — a status in the system. It can only be changed by WB. In the sandbox, you can emulate WB actions by manually changing the `wbStatus` field. Use the following statuses: | **wbStatus** | **supplierStatus** | Description | How to move the order to this status | |--------------|-------|----------------------|--------------------------------------| | **waiting** | **new** | New assembly order | [Create a test In-Store Pickup assembly order](./sandbox-environment#tag/marketplaceInStorePickup/operation/postV3TestClickCollectOrdersMake) | | **declined_by_client** | **new** | The assembly order was canceled by the buyer. It is available for one hour after [creating an assembly order](./sandbox-environment#tag/marketplaceInStorePickup/operation/postV3TestClickCollectOrdersMake), only in the sandbox. | [Notify that the buyer has canceled the order](./sandbox-environment#tag/marketplaceInStorePickup/operation/patchV3TestClickCollectOrdersOrderIdDecline) | | **waiting** | **confirm** | On assembly | [Transfer assembly order to assembly](/en/docs/openapi/in-store-pickup#tag/inStorePickupAssemblyOrders/operation/postV3ClickCollectOrdersStatusConfirm) | | **canceled** | **cancel** | The assembly order was canceled by the seller. Available before [notifying that the assembly order is ready for pickup](/en/docs/openapi/in-store-pickup#tag/inStorePickupAssemblyOrders/operation/postV3ClickCollectOrdersStatusPrepare). | [Cancel the assembly order](/en/docs/openapi/in-store-pickup#tag/inStorePickupAssemblyOrders/operation/postV3ClickCollectOrdersStatusCancel) | | **ready_for_pickup** | **prepare** | The order is ready for pickup | [Notify that the order is ready for pickup](/en/docs/openapi/in-store-pickup#tag/inStorePickupAssemblyOrders/operation/postV3ClickCollectOrdersStatusPrepare) | | **sold** | **receive** | The buyer has received the order | [Notify that the order has been accepted by the buyer](/en/docs/openapi/in-store-pickup#tag/inStorePickupAssemblyOrders/operation/postV3ClickCollectOrdersStatusReceive) | | **canceled_by_client** | **reject** | The buyer has canceled the order upon receipt | [Notify that the buyer has declined the order](/en/docs/openapi/in-store-pickup#tag/inStorePickupAssemblyOrders/operation/postV3ClickCollectOrdersStatusReject) |

post.description:
Описание метода
The deprecated method will be disabled on [5 November](/en/release-notes?id=602).

Описание метода
The method allows you to create test DBS assembly orders, emulating buyer's actions.

A single request creates assembly orders for items from one buyer's cart. They share a single transaction ID — `orderUid`, which is included in the responses of methods for retrieving [new](/en/openapi/dbs#tag/dbsAssemblyOrders/operation/getV3DbsOrdersNew) and [completed](/en/openapi/dbs#tag/dbsAssemblyOrders/operation/getV3DbsOrders) assembly orders.

An assembly order could be created if: 1. All item SKUs from the request have inventory in DBS warehouses. 2. The inventory in the warehouse is greater than or equal to the amount in the request. 3. The price of the item is not zero.

patch.summary: Notify that the Buyer has Canceled the Order{{ /api/v3/test/dbs/orders/{orderId}/decline }}
patch.description:
Описание метода
Method transfers the [assembly order](/en/openapi/dbs#tag/dbsAssemblyOrders/operation/getV3DbsOrdersNew) to the `"wbStatus":"declined_by_client"` — declined by the buyer. It is available for one hour after [creating an assembly order](./sandbox-environment#tag/marketplaceDbs/operation/postV3TestDbsOrdersMake).

The method emulates WB actions

It is available for one hour after [creating an assembly order](./sandbox-environment#tag/marketplaceFbs/operation/postV3TestFbsOrdersMake).

Описание метода
The method closes the FBS supply and marks all assembly orders as requiring [reshipment](/en/docs/openapi/orders-fbs#tag/fbsAssemblyOrders/operation/getV3SuppliesOrdersReshipment).

All `orderId` listed in the request are marked as requiring reshipment. Unspecified `orderId` related to the given `supplyId` are set to `"wbStatus": "sorted"`.

The method emulates WB actions

The method emulates WB actions

post.summary: Create Test In-Store Pickup Assembly Orders{{ /api/v3/test/click-collect/orders/make }}
post.description:
Описание метода
The method allows you to create test In-Store Pickup assembly orders, emulating buyer's actions.

A single request creates assembly orders for items from one buyer's cart with the same `orderCode` — buyer order ID, which is included in the response of the method for getting [new assembly orders](/en/openapi/in-store-pickup#tag/inStorePickupAssemblyOrders/operation/getV3ClickCollectOrdersNew).

An assembly order could be created if: 1. All item SKUs from the request have inventory in warehouses. 2. The inventory in the warehouse is greater than or equal to the amount in the request. 3. The price of the item is not zero.

patch.summary: Notify that the Buyer has Canceled the Order{{ /api/v3/test/click-collect/orders/{orderId}/decline }}
patch.description:
Описание метода
Method transfers the [assembly order](/en/openapi/in-store-pickup#tag/inStorePickupAssemblyOrders/operation/getV3ClickCollectOrdersNew) to the `"wbStatus":"declined_by_client"` — declined by the buyer. It is available for one hour after [creating an assembly order](./sandbox-environment#tag/marketplaceInStorePickup/operation/postV3TestClickCollectOrdersMake).

The method emulates WB actions

Описание метода
The method deletes [listings from the trash](/en/docs/openapi/item-management#tag/listings/operation/postV2GetCardsTrash). You can not restore the listings after deleting them. Use this method to free up space for creating new listings, including when approaching or reaching the [limit](/en/docs/openapi/item-management#tag/listingItems/operation/getV2CardsLimits) on the number of listings.
